title: imaps source
description: Polls a mailbox of an IMAP server over TLS and produces a message for every email that is unseen (unseen) and matches the search options, the oldest first. The body is the text of the email (text/plain, else text/html); the headers are Subject, From, To, Cc, Date, mail.messageId and mail.uid, and with content both an attachment.<file name> header for each attachment, as bytes, and attachments, the names. An email is marked as seen once the flow has processed it; if processing failed it stays unseen and is taken again.

path.title: Server
path.description: From the URI: imaps:<host>[:<port>]; the port is 993 by default

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for authenticationType basic; env DIF_IMAPS_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion). For Gmail an app password

authenticationType.title: Authentication
authenticationType.description: basic: username and password (LOGIN); oauth: username and accessToken (XOAUTH2)

accessToken.title: Access token
accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token for authenticationType oauth; @{name} is replaced by the tenant variable name (see oauth2token), for every poll

tenantDbName.title: Tenant
tenantDbName.description: Tenant of the variables in accessToken

content.title: Content
content.description: body: the text of the email; both: also its attachments, as headers

unseen.title: Unseen only
unseen.description: Only emails that are not marked as seen

fetchSize.title: Emails per poll
fetchSize.description: Most emails taken per poll; 0 or -1 for all

searchSubject.title: Subject
searchSubject.description: Only emails whose subject holds this text

searchBody.title: Body
searchBody.description: Only emails whose body holds this text

searchFrom.title: From
searchFrom.description: Only emails whose From holds this text

searchTo.title: To
searchTo.description: Only emails whose To holds this text

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds to connect, log in and open the folder

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)
